method: Exact current PE bytes, embedded Lua and bounded original instructions. No compiler, tests or application executed.

semantics.units: AZSUNITS schema kind,id,name,hp,hpm,state. Native mapper145514650 projects actor+88 lowu32 id; localized helper14540d290 name; max(actor+f0 HP,0); actor+f4 maxHP; guardian kind when guardian option+40 exists, state byte+60. Embedded GetGuardians filters kind guardian, awake state==1, and resolves debuffs through shared owner. Upstream full actor-list alive selection/order not reconstructed here.
semantics.lairs: Native145515b10 emits one row per lair, index starting1. For active option1 it searches matching GUID, skipping dead actor+68==1. Matching live holder gives GUIDlowu32/name, state awake if guardian flag+60nonzero else asleep, left=-1. Missing/dead holder gives empty/id0, selected enemy localized name, left=max(deadline-now,0). World coordinates always lair HOME.
semantics.map_projection: If map bounds Option is absent, mx=my=-1. For raw bounds[a,b,c,d], mx=(a-homeY)/(a-b),my=(c-homeX)/(c-d), no clamping. Native145515de6..145515e75 establishes lane ordering.
semantics.get_lairs: Embedded GetLairs adds active=(state!=empty) in place and returns all lair records.

limitations: Native wire serialization/escaping and float text formatting are outside addon.rs.
Delivery cadence, shared debuff records, actual VM/addon integration and upstream unit alive/order selection remain owning engine boundaries.
Source-only task: no compile, compiler check, compile-based test, game or runtime comparison.
